claims.summary: For every d>=3, the n=5 two-pair conic limit of lem:cube-two-pair-confluence is generically Hasse-normal in characteristic different from two except exactly when the characteristic is three and 16d-15=3^(4r) for r>=1. At each exception its generic length-(16d-16) jet corank is one.
claims.assessment: Working proof by an exact universal five-by-five determinant identity, a constant-coefficient restriction, Frobenius-constant-field independence for p>=5, and two characteristic-three factorizations. The remaining identity forces a pure power of three by comparing vanishing orders at one; the earlier explicit kernel supplies corank one.
claims.rationale: Completes the exceptional-set classification needed to combine the conic reduction with the elliptic repair, rather than adding finite cases.
claims.next_action: Apply the complete classification as input to higher-dimensional coupled limits without assuming blockwise normality composes.

claims.summary: Over every field of characteristic different from two and for every d>=2, the original generic dimension-five root-curve space V_(5,d)=span{T^s w_S:2s+|S|<=d}, wi^2=1+ai T and wi(0)=1, has Hasse order set {0,...,N_(2,5)(d)-1}. Here N_(2,5)(2)=17 and N_(2,5)(d)=16d-16 for d>=3. Degree-one orders and pre-stable threshold degrees are not asserted.
claims.assessment: Working proof: exact conic exception classification and the uniform elliptic repair cover every d>=3 in all odd characteristics. At d=2 the retained nonzero certificates cover the ten odd primes <=32, and the large-characteristic theorem covers all larger primes; characteristic zero follows as well. This moves the remaining small-prime stable-order obligation to dimensions n>=6, without proving the full per-order goal.
claims.rationale: Closes the dimension-five all-degree, all-odd generic-order obligation, replacing a finite degree range by a structural proof with a finite base case. Higher dimensions and finite-excess thresholds remain necessary; novelty outside the record is not claimed.
claims.next_action: At the due route review, assess the dimension-six two-pair elliptic limit with both character blocks and its marked coefficient map retained.

conj:cube-refined-initial-segment-law.mathematical_status: Dimension-five generic normality is now proved for every d>=2 in all odd characteristics; the remaining small-prime scope starts at n>=6.

conj:cube-refined-initial-segment-law.assessment: Conjecture in the remaining n>=6 small-prime range outside established subranges. Proved in characteristic zero for all n,d; in every characteristic not two for n<=5 and d>=2; for p>2^(n-1)d; and in the recorded periodic bands d=b+tp with b>=n-2 and p>2^(n-1)b, including the stated residue intervals. Degree-one orders retain the separate Catalan law. Generic normality does not determine pre-stable threshold degrees.
